name: Status Quo
description: Don't touch staffing in response to automation. No gain, no risk.

name: Downsize
description: Cut headcount to match automated capacity. Cheapest option; hits morale and trust.

name: Retrain
description: Invest in upskilling staff alongside automation. Costs cash; builds morale and trust.

name: Augment
description: Keep staff on as oversight for automated work. Modest savings, modest unease, safer outcomes.
